claims.statement: POST /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/payment is served by WxappPaymentController in ecshopx-orders (class-level @FrontNoAuth, no @FrontAuth on /payment or /payment/query, only /payment/config and /payment_deposit carry @FrontAuth); it merges query params with the flexible body, resolves company_id from wxapp/H5 auth attributes falling back to merged params, throwing UnauthorizedException when absent, rejects falsy trade_id on /payment/query with '支付单号不存在', and splits is_logistics items out of order_info.items into order_info.logistics_items.

WxappPaymentService.payment enforces the guard layer before trade creation: order_id is mandatory; an order_id starting with CZ is routed to DepositTradeWxappPaymentService.depositPayment; pay_type is mandatory unless auth_code is present (adapay additionally requires pay_channel); the order must exist in orders_associations, must not be order_type=supplier_order, its order_status must be NOTPAY or PART_PAYMENT; a zero cash total with point>0 forces pay_type=point; and updatePayTypeIfApplicable writes the chosen pay_type onto orders_normal_orders.

POST /wechatAuth/wxpay/notify is served by WxpayNotifyController in ecshopx-payment (@DingoResponse PLAIN, consumes XML/text/all, produces XML) and delegates one-for-one to WxpayNotifyFacade.handle; the /wechatAuth/ prefix exempts it from operator JWT auth, so every request must pass MD5 signature verification before any state is written.

WxpayNotifyFacade.handle loads and parses the XML body, resolves companyId from the notify appid (authorizer-appid port then Redis fallback maps), resolves the distributor-scoped wxPaymentSetting API key, verifies the MD5 signature, classifies result_code=SUCCESS to status SUCCESS (else the notify's trade_state, defaulting PAYERROR), and routes on the decoded attach: attach=depositRecharge goes to AlipayNotifyDepositSidePort.rechargeCallback, everything else to AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.applyTradePaymentAfterAlipay; pay_type is taken from the attach rather than the notify body.

WxpayNotifyFacade swallows business exceptions: the port call is wrapped in catch (BadRequestException | ResourceException) logged at debug ('wxpay notify business already handled'), and the facade still returns XML SUCCESS; only unexpected exceptions (signature failure, unparseable body, missing config) reach the outer catch and return XML FAIL with the message CDATA-escaped (cdataSafe neutralizes ']]>') — the HTTP status stays 200 and the return_code is the signal, so already-processed and unknown-trade notifies stop gateway retries.

ecshopx-payment depends on orders/deposit only through port interfaces: AlipayNotifyOrderSidePortImpl in ecshopx-orders delegates applyTradePaymentAfterAlipay one-line to OrdersTradePaymentCallbackService.applyTradePaymentNotify, and AlipayNotifyDepositSidePortImpl in ecshopx-deposit delegates rechargeCallback to AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackService (and resolves requireCompanyIdByDepositTradeId from the deposit row, throwing BadRequestException for a blank/unknown id) — despite the 'Alipay' name these ports are the shared side entry reused by the wxpay notify facade; the orders port also exposes resolveDistributorIdForAlipayRedis which returns the trade's distributor id only when the distributor's payment_subject=1.

OrdersTradePaymentCallbackService.applyTradePaymentNotify is the single mutation point for a channel-confirmed trade: blank out_trade_no throws '回调数据无效'; a missing trade throws '未查询到更新数据'; the entire notify map is serialized into trade.inital_response as JSON before the state guard (so replays refresh the audit trail); then the NOTPAY idempotency guard throws ResourceException '更新已处理，不需要更新' for any other trade_state; the guarded UPDATE sets trade_state/pay_type/pay_channel/bank_type/coupon_fee/coupon_info/transaction_id, and on SUCCESS additionally stamps time_expire (unix seconds) and trade_no from the Redis daily sequence; zero affected rows throws '交易单状态更新失败'.

trade_no is assigned only on the first SUCCESS, built as MMDD-seq from a Redis daily sequence: the h_trade_no_{company}_{distributor}_{MMdd} hash keyed by order id returns an existing entry, otherwise the c_trade_no_{company}_{distributor}_{MMdd} counter is incremented — so a repeated trade for the same order reuses its sequence number and the number rolls over daily.

Only a SUCCESS status publishes the trade-finish fan-out: publishSystemLinkTradeFinishAfterSuccess first fulfils the membercard VIP port for trade_source_type=membercard (PHP parity), converts the trade row to a snake_case map, and publishes it to three publishers — jushuitanTradeFinishDispatchPublisher, ordersTradeFinishDispatchPublisher and wdtErpTradeFinishDispatchPublisher; non-SUCCESS statuses (REFUND/CLOSED/REVOKED/PAYERROR) are written to trade_state but publish nothing.

OrdersTradeFinishDispatchPublisherBeansConfig exposes two OrdersTradeFinishDispatchPublisher beans, both backed by OrdersTradeFinishAfterCommitDispatchPublisher which registers a TransactionSynchronization and publishes after commit when a transaction is active (immediately otherwise): the @Primary bean publishes EVENT_TRADE_FINISH (event:291, the gateway-notify plane) and the qualified ordersTradeFinishDispatchPublisherOfflineCsv292 publishes EVENT_TRADE_FINISH_CSV292 (event:292, the admin offline bank-transfer approval plane); Jushuitan and WdtErp each ride their own dedicated ASYNC+REDIS events.

Every trade-finish listener registration config in ecshopx-bootstrap registers its listener on both EVENT_TRADE_FINISH and EVENT_TRADE_FINISH_CSV292 with the same listener name and options (e.g. TradeFinishSmsNotifyDispatchListenerRegistrationConfig at @Order(78) registers listener:orders.listeners.TradeFinishSmsNotify with ListenerDispatchOptions.async("sms", null) on both planes), so the twin planes share one listener set by design.

The pay-success bridge (OrdersTradeFinishNormalOrderPaySuccessApplyService.markPayedIfNeeded, one @Transactional method) only considers trade_state=SUCCESS payloads with positive company_id/order_id whose normalized trade_source_type is in NORMAL_TRADE_SOURCE_TYPES and whose NormalOrders row exists; it targets WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS for normal_groups, DONE for shopadmin-class orders unless the order uses platform item stock (uses_platform_item_stock != 0 — the 云仓 immediate-purchase case, which stays PAYED awaiting shipment per the in-code PHP-parity comment), otherwise PAYED; the header update is guarded by order_status='NOTPAY' and sets pay_status=PAYED — zero affected rows returns Optional.empty() so no pay-success event is published (the bridge is idempotent); it mirrors the status onto orders_associations, promotes supplier_order children from NOTPAY/PART_PAYMENT for PAYED/DONE targets, and for shopadmin/shopscreen ziti orders auto-completes delivery (non-logistics items marked delivered with auto-close-aftersales time, ziti_status=DONE, pure non-logistics orders closed to DONE).

The sibling internal path OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService.finalizeTradeSuccess (used by localPay/point/prepaid_point/pos/deposit and finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery for /payment/query) performs the same CAS guarded by WHERE trade_state='NOTPAY', the same trade_no assignment, membercard fulfilment and trade-finish publish — with one behavioural difference: when the trade is already SUCCESS it re-publishes the finish event idempotently instead of throwing, whereas finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery throws '更新已处理，不需要更新' for a non-NOTPAY non-SUCCESS state.

POST /payment/query (WxappPaymentService.query → OrdersPaymentTradeQueryService.resolve) is the polling fallback: an already-SUCCESS trade returns {status: SUCCESS, msg: 支付成功} without touching the channel; otherwise the channel is queried and when it reports SUCCESS, finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery performs the CAS flip (persisting transaction_id) and publishes the trade-finish event — the same fan-out reached from the client's poll instead of a notify.

The SMS listener (listener:orders.listeners.TradeFinishSmsNotify, @Order 78, async queue sms) runs TradeFinishSmsNotifyBusService.handleTradeFinishRow, which skips point/deposit pay types, requires a resolvable company, a non-blank passport uid and a non-blank mobile, formats pay_money as yuan (pay_fee/100) and pay_time from time_start, then calls TradePaySuccessTemplatedSmsPort.sendTradePaySuccess; send failures are caught and logged at debug.

WxappPaymentTradeFinishSmsNotifySyncDispatchFlowTest pins the SMS listener behaviour with a production-listener SyncDispatchDriver facade: a wxpay zero-fee payload with an eligible mobile sends exactly one templated SMS with pay_money=0.00 and the formatted pay_time, while a point pay type sends nothing at all (verifyNoInteractions on both the passport and the SMS port).

ecshopx.payment.wechat.notify-url ships in ecshopx-bootstrap/src/main/resources/application.properties with the default http://127.0.0.1/wechatAuth/wxpay/notify, an explicitly local placeholder (the file's own comment says the WeChat v2 unified-order async-notify URL must be publicly reachable, default is local placeholder only); ecshopx.payment.alipay.notify-url similarly defaults to http://localhost:8080/api/v1/alipay/notify. Overrides arrive per deployment via env vars or --key=value program arguments — ecshopx-bootstrap/src/main/resources/application-local.properties is git-ignored (.gitignore line 7) and not shipped. OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService injects the property with an empty-value default and a blank value fails the wxpay unify call with '不支持支付服务，请联系商家' before any request is built.

Admin POST /api/v1/order/create (NormalOrderController, @AdminAuth, routeAlias order.create) runs NormalOrderAdminCreateUserOrderService.createUserOrder → ShopadminNormalOrderCreateOrchestrator.create, which accepts only order_type=normal_shopadmin ('无此类型订单！'), runs the same staged pipeline as wxapp (need-params, operator-cart fill, item check, distributor check, format, assertDepositBalance) plus the non-transactional ShopadminNormalOrderCreateTransactionalRunner.preparePricingSnapshot, pre-assigns order_id via NormalOrderNumericIdService.generate(userId) with pay_type defaulting to pos, and writes a ShopadminDeferredOrderSnapshot (status WAIT_PAY, expireAt now+ttl, TTL = auto_cancel_time − now falling back to 15×60s) into shared Redis under shopadmin:deferred:{companyId}:{orderId} carrying the JSON-serialized params + orderData maps, payType and totalFee. No DB rows are written and no normal_order_add publish happens on create — the two probe tests verify only preparePricingSnapshot + saveWaitPay are invoked and the response returns the preassigned order_id with order_status=NOTPAY.

Admin POST /api/v1/order/payment (NormalOrderAdminPaymentService.payment, operator JWT auth with company_id from OPERATOR_JWT_USER_DATA) requires order_id plus pay_type or auth_code ('支付方式必填'), classifies auth_code by regex (^1[0-5][0-9]{16}$ → wxpaypos, ^(25|26|27|28|29|30)[0-9]{14,22}$ → alipaypos). It routes on the orders_associations lookup: when that row is missing but the deferred Redis cache has a snapshot for (company, order), it delegates to ShopadminDeferredOrderService.payDeferredOrder; otherwise the ordinary admin pay path runs (supplier_order rejection, NOTPAY/PART_PAYMENT guard, effective-type check, order bundle, point-forcing, pay-type persist, prescription/deposit/alipaymini guards) calling doPayment directly. payDeferredOrder re-derives the pay type (auth_code regex first, then request pay_type, then the snapshot's), only accepts DEFERRED_PAY_TYPES pos/wxpaypos/alipaypos ('暂不支持该支付方式'), answers '订单已退款' for a REFUNDED snapshot, and executes under the shopadmin:deferred:lock:{orderId} Redis lock (setIfAbsent + UUID token, 120s TTL, token-checked unlock; contention → '订单处理中，请稍后查询', Redis failure → '订单缓存不可用'/'订单处理繁忙，请稍后查询').

Inside the deferred lock, ShopadminDeferredOrderService.executeDeferredPaymentLocked: (1) an already-materialized orders_normal_orders row triggers recoverExistingOrder (markPayedIfNeeded when still NOTPAY, then re-split) and returns a paid response; (2) an existing SUCCESS/REFUND trade for the order answers '订单已退款' (REFUND) or materializes from the snapshot (SUCCESS); (3) otherwise it calls OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService.doPayment with data rebuilt from the snapshot (trade_source_type=normal, pay_fee = snapshot.totalFee, auth_code forwarded, ids/mobile/title from cached orderData, appids from operator auth) — pos finalizes synchronously, wxpaypos/alipaypos invoke the micropay/barcode channel in OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService returning pay_status=true plus transaction_id on synchronous confirmation (Alipay 10003 USERPAYING returns pay_status=false and leaves the snapshot WAIT_PAY); (4) on pay_status=true, persistAndFinishAfterPay runs ShopadminNormalOrderCreateTransactionalRunner.persistPreparedSnapshot (one @Transactional: persistOrder → minusStores → runAfterOrderInsert, reusing the preassigned order_id), then invokes OrdersTradeFinishNormalOrderPaySuccessApplyService.markPayedIfNeeded directly with the snake_case trade row, then splitAndPublishOnce runs SupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddService.split (which itself skips already-split suppliers) and publishes the single event:orders:normal_order_add payload {company_id, order_id, pay_type}, and finally deletes the cache entry.

The deferred charge publishes the trade-finish plane before any order row exists: doPayment's generic external-channel branch (wxpay*/alipay*/hfpay/offline_pay/paypal/doumen_intl, inside invokeExternalChannel, delegating to ordersExternalPayParamBuildService.buildPayParamsOrInvoke) returns a synchronously confirmed micropay/barcode charge whose pay_status=true makes TX2 (persistExternalPaymentInTx) call finalizeTradeSuccess, which publishes the trade-finish event through the after-commit publisher when that transactionTemplate transaction commits — i.e. before persistPreparedSnapshot creates the order. The pay-success bridge listener (order 77, markPayedIfNeeded.ifPresent(publish)) therefore finds no NormalOrders row and returns empty, so no event:288 NormalOrderPaySuccessEvent is published for a deferred order on this path; the direct markPayedIfNeeded call after materialization is what flips the shopadmin order to DONE, and its returned pay-success payload is ignored by the deferred service rather than forwarded to the pay-success publisher. Order-row-dependent trade-finish listeners no-op on the happy path: item sales (UpdateItemSalesBusService → TradeFinishItemSalesIncrementPortImpl reads order items) and profit sharing (TradeFinishProfitBusService reads order_profit rows written inside persistOrder via OrderProfitByOrderResultPortImpl) find nothing; trade-field-only listeners (statistics, pay-success SMS, websocket push, the '订单支付' OPL) are unaffected. supplementAfterPaymentQuery likewise never re-publishes the trade-finish plane — it re-applies markPayedIfNeeded and the supplier split only. Consumers that must react to a shopadmin order becoming paid should key off normal_order_add or the order row.

After a successful deferred charge, failure handling distinguishes exception types: a ResourceException (business rejection) triggers refundAfterBusinessFailure — a channel refund through WxpaySecapiAftersalesRefundRunner for wxpay* (secapi/pay/refund, merchant API cert, out_refund_no = orderId) or AlipayTradeAftersalesRefundRunner for alipay* (alipay.trade.refund, status SUCCESS or PROCESSING both count as ok), while pos is treated as refunded with nothing to reverse; on refund success the trade is CAS-flipped SUCCESS → REFUND (WHERE trade_state='SUCCESS') and the snapshot becomes REFUNDED, on channel failure it becomes REFUND_FAILED — both with the 24h COMPENSATION_TTL_SECONDS so operators can see and retry them — and the original exception is re-thrown. Any other RuntimeException marks the snapshot PAID_WAIT_ORDER (with the trade id, 24h TTL) and surfaces '订单创建失败，请稍后查询' — the money is held, not refunded.

GET /order/payment/query (NormalOrderController routeAlias order.payment.query; falsy trade_id rejected as '支付单号不存在') drives the deferred compensation: NormalOrderAdminPaymentQueryService.queryPayment resolves the trade through OrdersPaymentTradeQueryService.resolve (already-SUCCESS answers directly, otherwise the active channel is queried and a confirmed SUCCESS is finalized through finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery), then for a SUCCESS trade with a positive company_id calls ShopadminDeferredOrderService.supplementAfterPaymentQuery, which: recovers an already-materialized order (markPayedIfNeeded when still NOTPAY, then re-split), refunds-without-snapshot when the cache entry is gone entirely (channel refund + trade CAS to REFUND), retries the refund under the lock for a REFUND_FAILED snapshot (after first recovering an already-materialized order), does nothing for a REFUNDED one, and otherwise materializes the order from the snapshot under the lock with the same failure semantics as the payment call.

The workflow's entry sequence diagram covers both entries into the money path: the wxapp immediate-pay flow (order row pre-exists; payment initiation → TX1 ensure NOTPAY trade → channel unify invoked outside any DB transaction → TX2 persist payment_params/finalize → verified async notify → trade CAS → three-plane fan-out) and the admin shopadmin deferred flow (POST /api/v1/order/create caches only a Redis WAIT_PAY snapshot; POST /api/v1/order/payment routes to ShopadminDeferredOrderService.payDeferredOrder which, under the per-order Redis lock, charges pos/wxpaypos/alipaypos through OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService — whose generic external-channel delegation to ordersExternalPayParamBuildService.buildPayParamsOrInvoke sits at L378-L392 — lets doPayment's own trade-finish publish fire before any order row exists so the pay-success bridge no-ops, then materializes the order via persistPreparedSnapshot, applies markPayedIfNeeded directly, runs the supplier split and the single normal_order_add publish, and deletes the snapshot).

AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackService.rechargeCallback (ECX-10915) performs the deposit-trade status flip as a guarded conditional update that atomically takes over the row (aligned with PHP's FOR UPDATE + lock-then-check): it rejects a blank or unknown deposit_trade_id with '储值单不存在或主键无效，无法完成回调', ignores non-SUCCESS statuses entirely, throws '更新已处理，不需要更新' for an already-SUCCESS row, then runs an UPDATE carrying WHERE trade_status != 'SUCCESS' that sets trade_status/bank_type/transaction_id/pay_type/time_expire; zero affected rows throws the same already-handled '更新已处理，不需要更新', and the Redis balance credits (shopDepositTotal, user deposit total, dayRechargeTotal) and the after-commit recharge SMS job run only after the guarded update succeeds — so a concurrent or replayed double callback cannot credit the balance twice.

AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackServiceIdempotencyTest (bootstrap, ECX-10915) pins the deposit recharge guard: the update wrapper's SQL segment carries the trade_status guard; a takeover loss (guarded update returning 0) throws '更新已处理，不需要更新' with no addUserDepositTotal mutation, no Redis interaction and no SMS publish; and a successful first callback credits the user's deposit total exactly once (addUserDepositTotal(10,20,5000)).

Alipay's asynchronous notify POST /api/v1/alipay/notify (PaymentNotifyController, ecshopx-payment api/admin/v1, DingoResponse PLAIN) is handled by AlipayNotifyFacade.handle: AlipayNotifyPaymentContextLoader requires a passback_params parameter (absence yields {"data":[]}), transcodes params from the declared charset (default GB2312), and URL-decodes the passback carrying company_id/pay_type written at charge time by OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService; a missing or malformed company_id throws BadRequestException.

AlipayNotifyFacade enforces tenant ownership before signature verification: the owning company resolved from the trade row (AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.requireCompanyIdByTradeId) or deposit row (AlipayNotifyDepositSidePort.requireCompanyIdByDepositTradeId) must equal the passback company_id, otherwise BadRequestException (订单企业与回调企业不一致 / 储值单企业与回调企业不一致) is thrown before any RSA verification, as pinned by AlipayNotifyFacadeDepositSmsDispatchTest's mismatch cases that verify verification never runs.

The alipay notify's signature check is AlipayAsyncNotifyVerificationService.verifySignedNotify using AlipaySignature.rsaCheckV1 with the ali_public_key from (distributorId?)alipaySetting:sha1(companyId) in companys Redis (honouring sign_type, default RSA2); AlipayPaymentConfigValidationService.assertAsyncNotifyConfigComplete first requires app_id+ali_public_key+private_key, failing with 支付宝信息未配置，请联系商家.

AlipayNotifyFacade normalizes trade_status TRADE_SUCCESS/TRADE_FINISHED to SUCCESS, builds options with pay_type re-read from the passback and transaction_id from the notify's trade_no, routes attach=depositRecharge to AlipayNotifyDepositSidePort.rechargeCallback and everything else to AlipayNotifyOrderSidePort.applyTradePaymentAfterAlipay, and answers plain-text success on dispatch — but catches ANY exception in the outer catch and answers an empty-body HTTP 200 (no swallow-and-ack), so Alipay retries even already-handled business exceptions such as a replayed deposit recharge.

The alipay H5 sync return GET /payment/alipay/result (PaymentController.alipayResult) is handled by AlipayH5SyncReturnService: it requires the front H5 session company id (UnauthorizedException otherwise), verifies the return-URL signature with the same RSA service, then queries the channel via AlipayOpenapiTradeQueryService.queryTrade (alipay.trade.query) and trusts the channel's answer, re-parsing its passback_params, enforcing the same ownership checks, and dispatching on SUCCESS to the same order/deposit ports — so a lost async notify is repaired by the customer's browser landing on the result page.

In OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService the alipay charge family is: alipayh5 builds an alipay.trade.wap.pay form (product_code QUICK_WAP_WAY) carrying passback_params urlenc(company_id=<id>&pay_type=alipayh5) plus the configured ecshopx.payment.alipay.notify-url and the caller's return_url; alipaymini/alipayapp go through alipay.trade.app.pay returning an orderString; alipaypos is the synchronous alipay.trade.pay barcode call (FACE_TO_FACE_PAYMENT) whose synchronous confirmation finalizes the trade without any notify.

Wxapp deposit recharge (CZ-prefixed order_id via DepositTradeWxappPaymentService.depositPayment) supports wxpay channels only (other pay types are rejected with 无此类型支付！) and builds its attach as company_id=<enc>&pay_type=<enc>&attach=depositRecharge via DepositWxpayRechargeUnifyService; the alipay depositRecharge route on the notify/H5-return facades and the adapay callback handler therefore serves deposit trades created outside the wxapp front surface.

In the shopadmin deferred materialization path, splitAndPublishOnce relies on SupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddService.split's per-supplier select-count guard (skipping suppliers that already have a supplier_order row for the company/order/user/supplier key), which makes the recovery leg's re-split idempotent, and ShopadminDeferredOrderService defensively converts IllegalArgumentException from the direct markPayedIfNeeded call into ResourceException 支付状态更新失败.

OrdersPaymentDoPaymentService.doPayment runs as a three-phase transaction split: the config gate and (for bspay/adapay) the payment_params reuse run before any transaction; TX1 (preparePaymentInTx, one transactionTemplate execution) ensures a NOTPAY trade exists and completes all local payment types (zero-fee localPay, point, prepaid_point, deposit, pos) inside that single transaction; the channel SDK calls (invokeExternalChannel) run with no DB transaction open; and TX2 (persistExternalPaymentInTx, a second transactionTemplate execution) persists the channel outcome — bspay bspay_req_date/inital_request/transaction_id, adapay inital_request/transaction_id, and every channel's client map as payment_params JSON — and calls finalizeTradeSuccess when the client map carries pay_status=true. Local payment types therefore execute exactly one transaction and never touch an external channel, while external types execute two with the gateway call outside both — pinned by tx-depth probes and transaction-count verifications in OrdersPaymentDoPaymentServicePaymentSubjectTest and OrdersPaymentDoPaymentServiceWxappSyncTradeFinishPublishTest.

doPayment resolves the payment subject before charging: PaymentSubjectDistributorIdPort.resolveActualDistributorId (declared in ecshopx-common, implemented by PaymentSubjectDistributorIdPortImpl in the distribution bundle) returns the order's distributor id only when that distributor row exists and its payment_subject equals 1, and returns 0 (the platform merchant) for any other flag value, a missing distributor row, or distributor_id 0. The resolved id — not the order's distributor_id — is passed to assertPayConfigReady (which validates the (distributorId?)wxPaymentSetting:/(distributorId?)alipayPaymentSetting: Redis keys for that subject) and to OrdersExternalPayParamBuildService.buildPayParamsOrInvoke, so a distributor with payment_subject=1 charges against its own WeChat/Alipay merchant config while everyone else falls back to the platform config; the trade row itself still records the order's real distributor_id. OrdersPaymentChannelQueryService applies the same resolution before wxpay orderquery and alipay alipay.trade.query, and FrontPaymentSettingReadService uses it when listing the front-end payment types.

The wxpay/alipay config gate is payment-subject-aware: WxpayPaymentConfigValidationService.assertConfigComplete and AlipayPaymentConfigValidationService.assertConfigComplete read the (distributorId?)-prefixed Redis key for the resolved subject and throw distinct messages for a distributor-subject gap (店铺微信支付配置不完整，请先完成配置后再切换收款主体) versus a platform-config gap (平台微信支付配置不完整，请先完成配置后再切换收款主体, with alipay twins), while hfpay (missing port) and adapay (blank app_id) still fail with 不支持支付服务，请联系商家 — in every case before any trade row is persisted.

The internal trade-finish publish contract: every finalizeTradeSuccess converts the full Trade row to a snake_case map via the SNAKE_ROW Jackson mapper and publishes it through OrdersTradeFinishDispatchPublisher (the ecshopx-common interface implemented in orders by OrdersTradeFinishAfterCommitDispatchPublisher, which registers a TransactionSynchronization and publishes after commit when a transaction is active — so on the doPayment path the event fires when the enclosing TX1 or TX2 commits, immediately otherwise). finalizeTradeSuccessAfterChannelQuery(trade, transactionId, channelResult) is the channel-query-confirmed twin used by /payment/query and the admin deferred query leg: it runs the same NOTPAY→SUCCESS CAS, additionally persists the channel-reported transaction_id when present, performs the same publish, and differs only in throwing BadRequestException(更新已处理，不需要更新) when the trade is already in a non-NOTPAY non-SUCCESS state where finalizeTradeSuccess silently returns.

The alipay channel config is stored in companys Redis under (distributorId?)alipayPaymentSetting:{sha1(companyId)} (written by AlipayPaymentSettingWriter, read by AlipayPaymentConfigValidationService/AlipayNotifyFacade/AlipayH5SyncReturnService via PaymentSettingRedisKeys.alipayRedisKey) — not alipaySetting: — and wxpay under (distributorId?)wxPaymentSetting:{sha1(companyId)}; the numeric-distributor prefix on both keys is the per-distributor override the payment_subject resolution selects.
